verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a dedicated Resolve tool that "lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once", which matches the story directly. Only a single first-party sentence supports it, with no detail on how the tool works. missing for 10: detail on the Resolve tool's workflow (e.g. choosing ours/theirs, reviewing hunks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
